atomic_cutover: The compatibility package is deleted on one branch that merges as one pull request; no file under modules/workforce/legacy/timetracking survives it and no Go file imports the path. The services move file for file to modules/workforce/internal/application/timetracking and keep running on the native Workforce Postgres adapter through the same row mapping, which is now private to modules/workforce/compose (the shim file, its five constructors and their root bindings are deleted); so no SQL statement, transaction boundary, lock order or tenant predicate changes. The adapters that served the public contracts from services move into modules/workforce/compose, and the composition root binds the consumer-owned ports in services/time_tracking_ports.go. No DDL, no data migration, no write-owner change. The package carried no legacy.jsonl key, so none is retired and none is added; its nine rules are deleted or rewritten for the receiving roles under the epoch-gated exception of ADR 0052, and the rules naming #3413 for the timerecords vocabulary move to #3996.
